src: left-edge seed pixels s in the unique seed color
path: horizontal rays to the right; a hit obstacle paints open side wakes, and if obstacles occupy both forward diagonals the ray stops and branches rightward on the two adjacent rows
trajectory: paint reached background pixels with s.color
transform: keep all original seed and obstacle pixels unchanged; side-wake entry is blocked by an unactivated obstacle and split branches cannot paint back through their parent obstacle
multi_step: simulate rays left-to-right from each seed; obstacles reached inside wakes activate locally but do not become full beams unless created by a two-forward-diagonal split
